caveats.text: The source suppresses small cells before publication; rows absent from the source are absent here, never treated as zero activity.
NPPES identity fields come from nppes-2026-08, the NBER mirror of CMS NPPES (August 2026 vintage).

rules.definition: Research lead — Paid per claim line above specialty-state peer band (billing). The provider's Medicaid paid amount (published measure excluding outlier cells) per billing claim line sits at or above the 99th percentile of its peer group and at least 2.0 times the peer median. A research lead is a reason to look closer; it is not a finding of wrongdoing.

rules.name: Paid per claim line above specialty-state peer band (billing)
rules.peer_spec: Providers reporting the same NPPES primary taxonomy in the same NPPES practice state (NBER mirror of CMS NPPES, 2026-08), computed separately per role; fallback rungs: taxonomy national, then practice state across taxonomies. Minimum peer group size 30 entities clearing the rule's activity floor.
